notTokenised.note: styles.css declares these green-tinted --oai-gray-* properties (oklch hue 145), but the components render the plain hex Tailwind oai-gray-* steps above. TokenTracker's own DESIGN.md describes the tinted ramp; the rendered UI is neutral.
notTokenised.focusRing: Mostly none: styles.css sets `*:focus, *:focus-visible { outline: none !important }` and zeroes Tailwind's ring shadows. Only the sidebar's theme toggle, star pill and collapse chevron, and the Cloud page, override it with a 2px outline (core.focusRing). Light text fields turn their border emerald on focus (border.focus); dark ones do not change.

reducedMotion.what changes: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, the fade and modal keyframe animations stop (animation: none), the Cloud page's action popup and backdrop drop their transitions and their entry transform, and the plan cards' hover glow stops transitioning. Spinners and the sidebar's width and position transitions run only under no-preference. Colour transitions on hover (150 to 200ms) are not changed.
rules: .animate-tt-fade-in, .animate-tt-fade-out, .animate-tt-modal, .animate-tt-modal-exit { animation: auto ease 0s 1 normal none running none; }
.motion-safe\:animate-spin { animation: 1s linear 0s infinite normal none running spin; }
.motion-reduce\:animate-none { animation: auto ease 0s 1 normal none running none; }
reducedMotion.source: Measured: every rule inside a prefers-reduced-motion media query, and the motion-safe/motion-reduce utilities, in the dashboard stylesheet, raw/census.json sheet.reduced

notTokenised.otherHuesNote: Hues the stylesheet ships fewer steps of (mostly chart and provider colours). Listed with their steps; not tokenised.
notTokenised.warningNotice: The only rendered warning surface is a light-theme notice on Limits: amber-50 at 50% fill, amber-300 at 60% border (raw/census.json). Dark has none on screen, so no themed warning fill or border is tokenised.
notTokenised.providerColors: Per-provider colours (Claude orange, Codex blue, OpenCode purple) come from getProviderColor() in the dashboard source; data-viz only, not read as tokens.
